parameters.label: Mean temperature
parameters.description: Annual mean air temperature at the site.
parameters.sourceNote: NASA POWER T2M annual climatology, corrected from the POWER grid elevation to the site elevation using a 6.5 C/km lapse rate.

parameters.label: Temperature range
parameters.description: Typical day to night temperature swing.
parameters.sourceNote: NASA POWER T2M_MAX minus T2M_MIN annual climatology, a grid scale day to night range.

parameters.label: Radiation dose
parameters.description: Surface dose rate at the site.
parameters.sourceNote: Literature-informed estimate of the surface dose rate. Not retrieved from an instrument.

parameters.label: Terrain slope
parameters.description: Mean local slope over a 1 km window.
parameters.sourceNote: Mean absolute gradient of a 3x3 patch of the same DEM, about 250 m across, converted to degrees.

parameters.label: Soil composition
parameters.description: 0 to 100. How closely the surface material matches the target regolith (100 = mare basalt / basaltic Mars soil).
parameters.sourceNote: Literature-informed 0 to 100 index of how closely the surface material matches the target regolith.

parameters.label: Atmospheric pressure
parameters.sourceNote: NASA POWER PS annual climatology, corrected to the site elevation with the barometric formula and an 8.4 km scale height.

parameters.label: Daylight
parameters.description: Hours of daylight on the longest day of the year.
parameters.sourceNote: Computed from latitude for the summer solstice with the standard solar geometry formula. Exact, not measured.

parameters.label: Precipitation
parameters.description: Mean annual precipitation (rain plus snow water equivalent).
parameters.sourceNote: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR annual climatology times 365.25. Grid smoothed, so it is the weakest of the measured set.

parameters.label: Relative humidity
parameters.sourceNote: NASA POWER RH2M annual climatology. No elevation correction applied, so treat with care at high sites.

parameters.label: Dust activity
parameters.description: 0 to 100. Aeolian dust and aerosol loading proxy.
parameters.sourceNote: Literature-informed 0 to 100 aeolian dust and aerosol activity proxy.

parameters.label: Isolation
parameters.description: 0 to 100. Remoteness from people and infrastructure.
parameters.sourceNote: Literature-informed 0 to 100 remoteness from people and infrastructure.

parameters.label: Elevation
parameters.sourceNote: SRTM 30 m, or ASTER 30 m at the polar sites SRTM does not cover.

parameters.label: Aqueous geochemistry
parameters.description: 0 to 100. How closely the water and rock chemistry matches past or present aqueous environments.
parameters.sourceNote: Literature-informed 0 to 100 index of aqueous geochemistry match. The first version of this axis.

moon.name: Moon base
moon.description: Equatorial/mare global-mean reference for a permanent lunar base. South-pole (e.g. Artemis) targets are future work.

mars.name: Mars base
mars.description: Global-mean reference for a permanent Mars base.

presets.name: Lunar geology
presets.description: Terrain and soil chemistry first, the way a lunar mare field site would be picked. Raises the soil target to fresh basalt.

presets.name: Mars arid
presets.description: Cold, dry and dusty: the classic Mars desert analogue. Tightens the precipitation and humidity tolerances.

presets.name: Mars aqueous
presets.description: Raises the aqueous geochemistry target, so water altered sites such as Rio Tinto climb the table.

retrieval.climatology: NASA POWER source-native resolution annual climatology
retrieval.dem: SRTM 30 m via opentopodata, ASTER 30 m fallback at polar sites
